findings.title: Reject mutually displacing diagnostic feature families at compile time
findings.description: The guard excludes random/images/net from each other only. GUI+random/images/net selects7 desktop processes (8 for GUI probe), assigns slot4 to the compositor and disables system manifest/observer/poll routing, leaving the requested acceptance probe absent. Benchmark mixed with another family likewise lacks compile exclusion; its separate source check requires4 processes and would reject the larger manifest before userscheduling.
findings.reachability: Direct Cargo feature unions. Parent build.py reviewer confirmed the supported CLI accepts one exact profile and exposes no union route. No complete native-kernel build/VM was performed; the compiler reproduction uses unchanged frozen source excerpts and unique marker files instead of ELF bytes.
findings.policy_scope: Only the five families requested by root/parent: random, images, net including TCP, GUI, benchmark. Base native-system/clock/display-input and aliases inside one family stay positive.
findings.recommendation: Add compile-time mutual exclusion after feature implication; preserve all individual and same-family alias configurations.
findings.frozen_status: Open in c91714ba. Root accepted P2 and reported a planned guard fix outside this frozen commit.

source_review_observations.fact: Checked newly issued PID is stored in the actual process slot before manifests derive identities.
Single native-system uses init/key/volume/app at0..3; single random/images/net selects its separate fifth env alias at4.
IDs come from live State processes. Random captures actual key/probe PIDs and delegates two probe endpoint leaves; image probe is registered without service/device grants.
Saved PIDs resolve to live slots; actual app and probe identities stay separate rather than trusting later slot occupants.
Observer captures actual PID, boot slot and selected ELF fingerprint, validates startup mapping owner, snapshots before cleanup and matches PID+slot+live state.
GUI uses distinct7/8 image map and real PID startup fields; no old SYSTEM_APP alias. Raw display/input grants go to compositor/input source only.
GUI worker lookup returns None, matching no launch authority. Display/PS2 syscalls continue to check current PID and capability object.
Benchmark runs after real manifest setup and before timer/user scheduling; its four-principal invariant rejects larger manifests at runtime.

harness.method: Unchanged actual cfg guards/aliases/desktop map/native process_elf/fallback/initial-count expressions in isolated standard host program. Every image env points to unique marker bytes. Checks source routing, not ELF content/native execution. All43 compiler argv and feature closures in cfg-results.json.
